segments.Premeníme vaše tabuľky a systémy na preh: We turn your spreadsheets and systems into a clear dashboard — sales, orders and marketing in one place. Decide based on numbers. From €390 + €39/month.
segments.firemný dashboard, reporty z dát, analýz: business dashboard, data reporting, data analysis for businesses, sales overview, business intelligence for small businesses, data visualisation
segments.Interaktívny dashboard z vašich dát; pau: Interactive dashboard built from your data; monthly fee: regular dashboard updates
segments.Aké dáta potrebujete odo mňa?: What data do you need from me?
segments.Čokoľvek máte — Excel, Google Sheets, ex: Whatever you have — Excel, Google Sheets, exports from your online shop, invoicing or accounting system. Read-only access or a regular export is enough.
segments.Máme len tabuľky v Exceli, stačí to?: We only have Excel spreadsheets — is that enough?
segments.Áno. Väčšina našich klientov začína práv: Yes. Most of our clients start with spreadsheets. We can build the dashboard on top of them, too.
segments.Ako často sa dáta aktualizujú?: How often is the data updated?
segments.Podľa zdroja — typicky denne alebo v reá: Depending on the source — typically daily or in real time. With manual exports, after each upload.
segments.Uvidí moje dáta niekto iný?: Will anyone else see my data?
segments.Nie. Dáta ostávajú vo vašich účtoch, das: No. The data stays in your accounts, and the dashboard is protected so that only you and the people you choose can access it.
segments.Nerozumiem grafom a číslam, pomôžete?: I don’t understand charts and numbers — can you help?
segments.Áno — dashboard staviame tak, aby bol zr: Yes — we build the dashboard so that it’s easy to understand without any analytics background, and with reporting you also get a written commentary.

segments.Ktorá služba najviac zarába? Ktorý mesia: Which service earns the most? Which month was the weakest, and why? The answer is “I think…”.
segments.Koniec mesiaca = ručné kopírovanie čísel: End of the month = copying numbers by hand into a spreadsheet for yourself or your accountant.
segments.Pokles tržieb či rastúce náklady zistíte: You only notice falling sales or rising costs when they show up in the year-end statements.
segments.Tržby, náklady, objednávky, trendy — pre: Sales, costs, orders, trends — clearly on one screen, accessible from your computer and phone.
segments.Excel, Google Sheets, e-shop, fakturačný: Excel, Google Sheets, online shop, invoicing system — the data is loaded automatically.
segments.Mesiac vs. minulý mesiac, rok vs. minulý: Month vs. previous month, year vs. previous year. You see the development, not just a snapshot.
segments.Pokles tržieb či nezvyčajný náklad? Dozv: Falling sales or an unusual cost? You find out straight away, not six months later.
segments.Pri mesačnom reportingu dostanete okrem: With monthly reporting you get not only the numbers but also a clear explanation of what they mean.
